Catalogue frame-quality scores were unavailable for the WISE frames from 2010 (cryogenic), 2010 (three-band), so those frames were checked by their measured pixel noise instead.
3 of 350 SPHEREx spectrum points are left out (3 where too much of the target is covered by bad pixels).
The Gaia DR3 and CatWISE2020 lists were reused from the view built on 15 Nov 2026, because the catalogue services did not answer.

The spectrum is not classified because a brighter catalogued source (W1 16.6) 2.0 arcsec away falls inside the area the SPHEREx photometry is fitted over; its light there is estimated at 2 times the target's own, or more.
4 detections are left out of the motion fit because a catalogued source of similar brightness lies within the area the position is fitted over.

field_movers.sentence: We searched this patch for anything else that moved between 2010 and 2024. We found nothing unexplained. The search also picked up the target itself without being told where it is.
